title: What's new in Expense Agent: Use Travel Request (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction and purpose of travel requests
Travel request workflow and process overview
Travel request details and line items
Posted expense report and audit trail
Foreign currency budgeting for volatile markets

features.name: Travel Request
features.description: Feature allowing employees to request permission to spend money before travel, specifying amount, dates, destination, and purpose for manager approval.
caveats: Phone app and web app versions not yet ready at time of recording

features.name: Travel Request Line Items
features.description: Ability to itemize expenses within a travel request by category (flight, hotel, etc.) and specify currency per line item.

features.name: Expense Ledger Entries Link
features.description: GL entries created during expense report posting are linked back to the original travel request for audit traceability.

features.name: Foreign Currency Budgeting
features.description: Ability to budget travel request amounts in foreign currency and update local currency equivalents to account for exchange rate volatility.
caveats: Useful for volatile currency or high inflation scenarios

features.name: Automatic Expense Report Creation from Web/Phone App
features.description: When travel request is created in the expense agent web or phone app, the corresponding expense report is created automatically.
caveats: Only applies to expense agent web and phone apps, not Business Central client

features.name: Employee Ledger Entry for Reimbursement
features.description: Employee ledger entries are created for reimbursement amounts when expense reports are posted.

features.name: Travel Request with Multiple Travelers
features.description: Travel requests can include a list of travelers, allowing group travel to be tracked in a single request.
